It features a 3440 x 1440 resolution, 240Hz refresh rate, 0.03ms response time, USB-C input with 90W power delivery, and an adjustable stand with height, tilt, and swivel support. Designed for desktop use rather than storage or graphics hardware, it targets users who want a premium wide-format monitor with rich contrast and smooth motion.
